description: Use when a router agent must pick which paid x402 service to send a task to: send the task in plain words. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /route, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Returns a recommendation for one task; to browse or compare services use search_x402_services.

task.description: the task in plain words, e.g. 'screen a wallet address for sanctions' (2-200 characters)

name: best_service_for_task
title: Best service for task
